name: @loopx/workbench
description: Run coding agents on a remote host and drive them from a browser.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @calli/daemon && npm run build -w @calli/web && npm run build -w @calli/ext-loopx
scripts.test: npm test -w @calli/daemon && npm test -w @calli/web && npm test -w @calli/ext-board && npm test -w @calli/ext-loopx
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @calli/daemon && npm run typecheck -w @calli/web && npm run typecheck -w @calli/ext-board && npm run typecheck -w @calli/ext-loopx && npm run typecheck -w @calli/ext-memory && npm run typecheck -w @calli/ext-voice
